prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. Portrait cover photograph: a breathtaking blue-eyed cream ragdoll cat, extreme low-angle wide-lens portrait, curled on a sculptural pale butter-yellow pedestal, one velvet paw resting over the front edge, looking directly into camera with a tiny curious head tilt. Powder-blue seamless cyclorama, a translucent warm sunbeam, beautiful fluffy chest and delicate ears fully in frame. The face dominates the upper centre; fluffy paw and chest below. Fashion magazine quality, tender yet confident. No text. Intended final composition 1440:1800; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
